definitions.explanation: The act of dividing something into separate parts or sections. Used for physical objects, payments, data, and abstract concepts.

examples.japanese: {分割|ぶんかつ}{払|ばら}いにする。
{土地|とち}を{三|みっ}つに{分割|ぶんかつ}した。
examples.english: The land was divided into three parts.

examples.japanese: {画面|がめん}を{分割|ぶんかつ}して{二|ふた}つのアプリを{同時|どうじ}に{表示|ひょうじ}できる。
examples.english: You can split the screen and display two apps at the same time.

notes:
Compound of {分|ぶん} (to divide) + {割|かつ} (to split). A common word in finance, technology, and everyday contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{分割|ぶんかつ}する (to divide, to split)
・{分割|ぶんかつ}{払|ばら}い (installment payment)
・{分割|ぶんかつ}{統治|とうち} (divide and rule)
・{画面|がめん}{分割|ぶんかつ} (split screen)
・{株式|かぶしき}{分割|ぶんかつ} (stock split)
・{分割|ぶんかつ}ファイル (split file)
・〜を{二|ふた}つに{分割|ぶんかつ}する (to divide ~ into two)

DISTINCTIONS:
・{分割|ぶんかつ}: dividing one thing into defined parts (often deliberate, planned)
・{分離|ぶんり}: separating things that were connected
・{分裂|ぶんれつ}: splitting apart, often with a sense of conflict or fragmentation
